entries.origin_analysis: The exact B02/F05 Entry/Exit reproduction found that P2 and P1 failures become distinguishable after executable profit, while immediate Entry-local features were not portable. HYP-024 froze a common directional-state collapse primitive with separate P2 and P1 arms before outcomes.
entries.causal_hypothesis: After first executable profit, synchronized collapse of four-M15-open momentum, MACD histogram and price-to-EMA20 distance identifies nonrecovering P2 or P1 failure without materially damaging continuation Winners.
pre_result_predictions: at least two Manhattan-adjacent core cells occur within one arm
at least one full cell belongs to that component
target-class benefit remains positive in every fold
top-decile Winner retention remains at least 0.90
B02, F05, long, short and both quarters remain nonnegative
entries.decision: Close HYP-024 and Family O before MT4 parity or 2025 access. No cell may be selected from positive target-class benefit or an isolated favorable fold.
falsified_or_unsupported_claims: the frozen collapse state preserves total expectancy across all four folds
P2 benefit survives Winner, strategy, direction, quarter and date-breadth gates
P1 giveback reduction preserves the Winner right tail
either arm forms an eligible connected family region
retained_findings: all 32 candidate-fold rows have positive target-class benefit and adequate target activation
P2 O_P2_Q2_R1 improves 2023H1 by 773.9 pips but reverses in the other three folds
P1 O_P1_Q3_R2 is positive only in 2023H2 and fails the quarter gate even there
the missing discriminator is continuation-Winner preservation rather than loss-event detection
prohibited_reuse: do not alter quorum persistence components arms or execution timing
do not combine P2 and P1 cells
do not run HYP-024 on MT4 or 2025
do not repair from fold or trade outputs
successor_questions: A future successor requires new observable information that separates state collapse in terminal failures from state collapse during profitable continuation; none is authorized in this execution thread.
